blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Diffusion language models generate text by reversing a classical diffusion process over token sequences. We show that their continuous-time forward and reverse dynamics can be embedded in the framework of open quantum systems, which describes quantum systems interacting with their environment. This connection provides a basis for extending diffusion sampling to superpositions of sentence states and for modifying the underlying generation dynamics. We construct a $τ$-leaping unraveling scheme that simulates stochastic trajectories of these states while updating multiple token positions at each step. This enables generation conditioned on superposed prompts or thoughts, which we call Superposition of Prompts (SoP) and Superposition of Thoughts (SoT). The same formulation yields Quantum-Inspired Remasking (QIR): perturbing the masked-diffusion dynamics produces a confidence-based rule for revising previously generated tokens. Experiments with pretrained diffusion language models show that superposition-based generation can retain information from conditioning components not selected at the final measurement, while QIR improves LLM-assessed text quality when applied at an appropriate stage of generation.
blocks.zh: 分化语言模型通过倒置一个经典的传播过程而不是符号序列来生成文本. 我们显示,它们的连续时间前向和倒向动力学可以被嵌入到开放式量子系统的框架中,这个框架描述了量子系统与环境相互作用. 这种连接为将扩散取样扩展到句子状态的叠位以及修改基本的生成动力提供了基础. 我们设计了一个美元折叠方案, 模拟这些州的花样轨迹, 同时更新每个步骤的多个标志位置。 这使得生成以叠加的提示或想法为条件,我们称之为"叠加提示"(SoP)和"叠加想法"(SOT). 同一配方产生量子-启发重塑(QIR):扰动被遮掩的分化动态产生一个基于信任的规则来修订之前生成的符. 使用被预先训练的传播语言模型的实验表明,基于超位的生成可以保留在最终测量时没有选择的调制组件中的信息,而QIR在适当的生成阶段应用时会提高LLM评估的文本质量.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Diffusion models have achieved remarkable success in generative tasks such as image and video synthesis ( Sohl-Dickstein et al., 2015 , Ho et al., 2020 , Song and Ermon, 2019 , Song et al., 2021b , Dhariwal and Nichol, 2021 , Rombach et al., 2022 , Ho et al., 2022 , Singer et al., 2023 ) .
Diffusion-based approaches are also increasingly being explored for text generation as an alternative to autoregressive models ( Sun et al., 2023 , Lou et al., 2024 , Xu et al., 2025 , Ou et al., 2025 , Sahoo et al., 2025 , Nie et al., 2025 , Zhao et al., 2025 ) , including recent commercial systems ( Khanna et al., 2025 , Song et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh:
传播模型在影像和视频合成等基因组任务上取得了显著成功(Sohl-Dickstein等人,2015年;Ho等人,2020年;Song and Ermon,2019年;Song等人,2021年b;Dhariwal and Nichol,2021年;Rombach等人,2022年;Ho等人,2022年;Singer等人,2023年).
还越来越多地探索以传播为基础的方法,以生成文本作为自动递减模型的替代品(Sun等人,2023年;Lou等人,2024年;Xu等人,2025年;Ou等人,2025年;Sahoo等人,2025年;Nie等人,2025年;Zhao等人,2025年),包括最近的商业系统(Khanna等人,2025年;Song等人,2025年)。

blocks.en:
From a theoretical point of view, diffusion models are deeply connected to stochastic processes in non-equilibrium statistical mechanics ( Sohl-Dickstein et al., 2015 ) .
This connection has motivated a growing body of work that analyzes diffusion models using concepts and formulations developed in physics ( Hirono et al., 2024 , Yu and Huang, 2024 , Yaguchi et al., 2025 , Ikeda et al., 2024 ) .
Conventional diffusion models can be viewed as analogs of classical thermal systems, whose dynamics can be described within a more general quantum framework.
blocks.zh:
从理论角度来看,传播模型与非均匀统计力学中的斯图克化过程有着深刻的联系(Sohl-Dickstein等人,2015年).
这种联系激发了越来越多的工作,利用物理学中形成的概念和配方分析扩散模型(Hirono等人,2024年;Yu和Huang,2024年;Yaguchi等人,2025年;Ikeda等人,2024年)。
常规扩散模型可以看作是古典热学系统的模拟,其动力学可以在更一般的量子框架内描述.

blocks.en:
In this paper, we formulate diffusion language models within the framework of open quantum systems ( Breuer and Petruccione, 2002 , Lindblad, 1976 , Gorini et al., 1976 ) .
Specifically, we show that their continuous-time dynamics can be embedded in the Lindblad equation, which describes the evolution of a quantum system interacting with its environment.
This formulation opens the way to extensions of diffusion sampling based on concepts from quantum physics.
One such concept is superposition .
As illustrated in Figure 1 , distinct sentences can be represented as basis states, and a linear combination of these states defines a superposition state | 𝛙 t ⟩ |\bm{\uppsi}_{t}\rangle .
Superposition is fundamentally different from concatenation: the sentences remain distinct alternatives within a quantum state, rather than becoming successive parts of a longer text.
The corresponding density operator evolves according to the Lindblad equation.
This representation introduces a form of generation in which multiple sentence components and their relative weights evolve together, with the components influencing one another rather than evolving as independent samples.
blocks.zh:
在本文中,我们在开放量子系统的框架内制定传播语言模型(Breuer和Petruccione,2002年;Lindblad,1976年;Gorini等人,1976年)。
具体来说,我们表明它们的连续时动态可以嵌入林德布拉德方程中,它描述了一个量子系统与其环境相互作用的演变.
这种配体为基于量子物理概念的传播取样的延伸开辟了道路.
这种概念之一是叠加。
如图1所示,不同的句子可以作为基准状态表示,这些状态的线性组合定义了一个叠加状态 QQ t ⟩ bm {\uppsi}_{t}\rangle 。
超位与调和有根本区别:句子在量子状态下仍然是不同的替代品,而不是成为较长文本的连续部分.
相应的密度运算符根据Lindblad方程演化.
这种表述引入了一种生成形式,即多个句子组件及其相对权重一起演化,其组件相互影响,而不是作为独立样本演化.

blocks.en: Figure 1: A superposition of sentence states viewed as an open quantum system interacting with its environment.
blocks.zh: 图1:句子的叠加状态表示被视为一个与其环境相互作用的开放式量子系统.

blocks.en:
We develop a sampling procedure based on τ \tau -leaping unraveling, which evolves superpositions of sentence states by updating multiple token positions in each step.
It builds on stochastic unraveling , an established technique for representing Lindblad dynamics through stochastic pure-state trajectories ( Dalibard et al., 1992 , Dum et al., 1992 , Carmichael, 1993 ) .
The idea is analogous to simulating trajectories of a stochastic differential equation instead of directly solving the corresponding Fokker–Planck equation.
A final measurement selects an output sentence according to the Born rule.
The same formulation also leads to quantum-inspired remasking: a perturbation of the masked-diffusion dynamics yields a confidence-based rule that preferentially remasks tokens the model is less confident in reconstructing from their context.
blocks.zh:
我们开发一个基于\tau-leating破解的取样程序,通过更新每个步骤的多个符号位置来演化句子的叠加状态.
它以Stochastic explaction 为基础,是一种通过Stochtic 纯态轨迹来代表Lindblad动力学的既定技术(Dalibard等人,1992年;Dum等人,1992年;Carmichael,1993年)。
这个想法类似于模拟一个浮微分方程的轨迹,而不是直接解决相应的Fokker - Planck方程.
最后的测量根据Born规则选择一个输出句.
同样的配方也会导致量子启发的重现:对遮掩的分散动力的扰动产生一种基于信心的规则,即优惠的重现表示模型对从上下文重建的信心较低.

blocks.en:
Our main contributions are summarized as follows: • We show that continuous-time discrete diffusion language models can be embedded in the Lindblad equation, with reverse diffusion recovered in the diagonal sector of the reverse-time dynamics. This embedding allows us to extend diffusion language models by modifying the dynamics or allowing superpositions of sentence states. • By allowing superpositions in the same formulation, we introduce Superposition of Prompts (SoP) and its application to thought-conditioned generation, Superposition of Thoughts (SoT) .
These methods generate a text through stochastic unraveling followed by measurement. Our experiments show that the output can retain information from conditioning components that are not selected in the final measurement. • By perturbing the embedded masked diffusion dynamics, we derive Quantum-Inspired Remasking (QIR) .
Our experiments show that appropriately timed QIR improves LLM-assessed text quality, whereas applying it too early increases repetition despite lowering perplexity. These methods illustrate the broader design space opened by our formulation, which brings concepts from quantum physics into the design of language generation processes.
Exploring this space may lead to further sampling methods on classical hardware, as well as future implementations on quantum computers.
blocks.zh:
• 我们的主要贡献概述如下: 我们显示,连续时间离散扩散语言模型可以嵌入到Lindblad方程中,反向扩散在逆时动态的对角部分恢复. 这种嵌入使我们能够通过修改动态或允许句态的叠加来扩展扩散语言模型. ^ 通过允许在同一配方中的叠加,我们引入了叠加叠加(SoP)及其应用于有思想条件的生成,叠加叠加(SOT).
这些方法通过分解和测量生成文字。 我们的实验表明,产出可以保留最终测量中没有选择的调制组件的信息。 通过扰动嵌入式的蒙面扩散动力学,我们得出量子-启发式重塑(QIR).
我们的实验表明,适当定时的QIR可以提高LLM评估的文本质量,而应用得太早,尽管模糊性降低,但重复性却增加。 这些方法说明了我们配方所打开的更广泛的设计空间,它把从量子物理学到语言生成过程的设计的概念.
探索这一空间可能导致在古典硬件上进一步采样方法,以及未来在量子计算机上的应用.

blocks.en: We show that continuous-time discrete diffusion language models can be embedded in the Lindblad equation, with reverse diffusion recovered in the diagonal sector of the reverse-time dynamics. This embedding allows us to extend diffusion language models by modifying the dynamics or allowing superpositions of sentence states.
blocks.zh: 我们显示,连续时间离散扩散语言模型可以嵌入到Lindblad方程中,反向扩散在逆时动态的对角部分恢复. 这种嵌入让我们通过修改动态或者允许句子状态的叠加来扩展扩散语言模型.

blocks.en:
By allowing superpositions in the same formulation, we introduce Superposition of Prompts (SoP) and its application to thought-conditioned generation, Superposition of Thoughts (SoT) .
These methods generate a text through stochastic unraveling followed by measurement. Our experiments show that the output can retain information from conditioning components that are not selected in the final measurement.
blocks.zh:
通过允许在同一配方中的叠加,我们引入了叠加叠加(SoP)及其应用于有思想条件的生成,叠加叠加(SOT).
这些方法通过分解和测量生成文字。 我们的实验显示,输出可以保留在最终测量中未选择的调制组件中的信息.

blocks.en:
By perturbing the embedded masked diffusion dynamics, we derive Quantum-Inspired Remasking (QIR) .
Our experiments show that appropriately timed QIR improves LLM-assessed text quality, whereas applying it too early increases repetition despite lowering perplexity.
blocks.zh:
通过扰动嵌入式的蒙面扩散动力学,我们得出量子-启发式重塑(QIR).
我们的实验表明,适当定时的QIR可以提高LLM评估的文本质量,而应用得太早,尽管模糊性降低,但重复性却增加。

blocks.en: 1.1 Related Works
blocks.zh: 1.1 相关工程

blocks.en:
Diffusion Language Models. Discrete diffusion models were initially introduced for binary data ( Sohl-Dickstein et al., 2015 ) and later extended to discrete state spaces.
Our mathematical foundation is the continuous-time Markov formulation of discrete diffusion ( Campbell et al., 2022 , Sun et al., 2023 ) , particularly that of Lou et al. (2024) .
Two widely studied approaches are uniform diffusion and masked diffusion .
blocks.zh:
传播语言模型.  Discrete 扩散模型最初被引入二进制数据(Sohl-Dickstein等人,2015年),后来扩展至离散状态空间.
我们的数学基础是离散扩散的连续时间马可夫配体(Campbell等人,2022年;Sun等人,2023年),尤其是Lou等人的配体(2024年)。
两种广泛研究的方法是统一传播和掩盖传播。

blocks.en:
Uniform diffusion allows tokens to be revised throughout generation, providing a mechanism for correcting earlier predictions ( Hoogeboom et al., 2021 ) .
Although early models faced challenges in language modeling ( Austin et al., 2021 , Lou et al., 2024 ) , recent advances have improved training ( Sahoo et al., 2025 ) and led to practical open-weight models ( DiffusionGemma Team et al., 2026 ) .
Masked diffusion generates a text by progressively replacing mask tokens and has been widely adopted for its stable training ( Austin et al., 2021 , Lou et al., 2024 ) . Ou et al. (2025) showed that the structure of masked diffusion permits time-independent modeling and reduces the number of function evaluations during sampling.
Masked diffusion also underlies large-scale language models such as LLaDA ( Nie et al., 2025 ) and iLLaDA ( Nie et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh:
统一传播允许代代相传修改令牌,为纠正先前的预测提供了一个机制(Hoogeboom等人,2021年)。
虽然早期的模型在语言建模方面面临挑战(Austin等人,2021年;Lou等人,2024年),但近期的进步改善了培训(Sahoo等人,2025年),并导致了实用的开放量级模型(DifmuationGemma Team等人,2026年).
蒙面扩散通过逐渐取代面具符来生成文本,并被广泛采用来进行稳定的训练(Austin等人,2021年;Lou等人,2024年)。 Ou等人(2025年)表明,蒙面扩散的结构允许时间独立的建模,并减少了取样期间功能评价的数量.
蒙面传播也是LLADA(Nie等人,2025年)和iLLADA(Nie等人,2026年)等大规模语言模型的基础.

blocks.en:
Standard masked diffusion cannot revise tokens once unmasked. Remasking allows these tokens to be masked again and regenerated. Nie et al. (2025) retain a prescribed number of token predictions based on confidence at each step.
WINO ( Hong et al., 2026 ) also revisits previously generated tokens, remasking those below a verification confidence threshold.
Our QIR instead derives stochastic remasking rates from perturbed Lindblad dynamics, assigning higher rates to tokens with lower reconstruction confidence.
Alternatively, Wang et al. (2026) reformulate sampling to incorporate remasking, drawing on DDIM ( Song et al., 2021a ) .
blocks.zh:
标准蒙面扩散一旦被揭开,就不能修改符号。 Remasking允许这些令牌再次蒙上面具并重新生成. 涅盘等. (2025年)保留了根据每一步的置信度而设定的表示数预测.
WINO(Hong等人,2026年)也重新审视了以前产生的符号,重新装出那些低于核查信任阈值的符号.
我们的QIR则从扰动的Lindblad动态中得出了令人毛骨悚然的重现率,将更高的率分配给重建信心较低的标志。
或者,Wang等人(2026年)根据DDIM重新编制取样,以纳入重塑(Song等人,2021年a) 。 。 。

blocks.en: Quantum Computation and Diffusion Models. The connection between quantum computation and generative modeling has been explored in several directions. Early approaches include quantum generative models such as quantum Boltzmann machines and variational quantum circuits ( Amin et al., 2018 , Biamonte et al., 2017 , Benedetti et al., 2019 ) , where probability distributions are represented by quantum states and sampled via measurement.
blocks.zh: 量子计算与扩散模型. 量子计算与基因建模之间的联系在几个方面得到了探索. 早期的方法包括量子基因模型,如量子波尔茨曼机和变异量子电路(Amin等人,2018年;Biamonte等人,2017年;Benedetti等人,2019年),其中概率分布以量子状态为代表,并通过测量进行采样.

blocks.en:
Diffusion Models and Physics. Diffusion models have been studied from the perspectives of
non-equilibrium statistical mechanics and stochastic processes ( Sohl-Dickstein et al., 2015 , Hirono et al., 2024 , Yu and Huang, 2024 , Yaguchi et al., 2025 , Ikeda et al., 2024 ) .
Connections between classical diffusion and quantum dynamics also arise through imaginary-time evolution and path-integral formulations ( Feynman and Hibbs, 1965 ) . Nasu et al. (2025) connect Lindblad dynamics to classical reverse diffusion through a semiclassical approximation.
Our work considers an exact embedding of discrete token dynamics and uses it to develop sampling procedures for diffusion language models.
blocks.zh:
传播模型与物理. 从以下角度研究了传播模式:
(Sohl-Dickstein等人,2015年;Hirono等人,2024年;Yu和Huang,2024年;Yaguchi等人,2025年;Ikeda等人,2024年)。
古典扩散和量子动力学之间的联系也通过假想-时间演化和路径-集成配体产生(Feynman and Hibbs, 1965.). 纳苏等人. (2025)通过半古典近似法将Lindblad动态与古典反向扩散联系起来.
我们的工作考虑精确地嵌入离散符号动态,并利用它制定传播语言模型的取样程序。

blocks.en: 2.2 Open Quantum Systems and the Lindblad Equation
blocks.zh: 2.2 开放量子系统和Lindblad方程

blocks.en:
An open quantum system describes the effective dynamics of a quantum system interacting with its environment.
Its state is represented by a density operator ρ t {\rho}_{t} on a Hilbert space ℋ \mathcal{H} .
Classical probability distributions are recovered as a special case.
Given the sentence basis { | 𝐦 ⟩ } 𝐦 ∈ 𝕍 N \{\ket{\mathbf{m}}\}_{\mathbf{m}\in\mathbb{V}^{N}} , a probability distribution p t ​ ( 𝐦 ) p_{t}(\mathbf{m}) over sequences can be embedded into a diagonal density operator, ρ t = ∑ 𝐦 ∈ 𝕍 N p t ​ ( 𝐦 ) ​ | 𝐦 ⟩ ​ ⟨ 𝐦 | . \displaystyle{\rho}_{t}=\sum_{\mathbf{m}\in\mathbb{V}^{N}}p_{t}(\mathbf{m})\ket{\mathbf{m}}\bra{\mathbf{m}}. (7) Thus, a discrete diffusion process can be viewed as open-system dynamics restricted to the diagonal sector.
Going beyond this diagonal sector amounts to allowing coherent superpositions of token sequences, which will be exploited later in our sampling construction.

The Markovian dynamics of an open quantum system is governed by the Lindblad equation, d d ​ t ​ ρ t \displaystyle\frac{d}{dt}{\rho}_{t} = − i [ H t , ρ t ] + ∑ μ L t μ ρ t L t μ † − 1 2 { ∑ μ L t μ † L t μ , ρ t } . \displaystyle=-i[{H}_{t},{\rho}_{t}]+\sum_{\mu}{L}_{t}^{\mu}{\rho}_{t}{L}_{t}^{\mu\dagger}-\frac{1}{2}\left\{\sum_{\mu}{L}_{t}^{\mu\dagger}{L}_{t}^{\mu},{\rho}_{t}\right\}. blocks.en:
We now show that diffusion language models can be embedded in the Lindblad framework for open quantum systems.
Specifically, the discrete diffusion dynamics can be reproduced by choosing jump operators that act on individual token positions, following the transition structure in Equation 5 .
The following theorems establish this correspondence.
The proofs are given in Appendix D .

blocks.en: 3.2 Simulations: Stochastic Unraveling

The Lindblad formulation also provides a trajectory-level description of the dynamics.
In ordinary diffusion language models, sampling is performed by simulating a Markov process over token sequences.
The open-system counterpart is a stochastic process over wave functions, known as stochastic unraveling .
It represents the same density-operator dynamics through random pure-state trajectories.
In this language, a stochastic time-evolution operator U t − d ​ t | t eff {U}_{t-dt|t}^{\text{eff}} updates the state vector as | 𝛙 t − d ​ t ⟩ = U ~ t − d ​ t | t eff ​ | 𝛙 t ⟩ \displaystyle\ket{\bm{\uppsi}_{t-dt}}=\tilde{U}_{t-dt|t}^{\text{eff}}\ket{\bm{\uppsi}_{t}} ∝ ( 1 − i H ~ d t eff t ) | 𝛙 t ⟩ + ∑ μ ( L ~ − μ t 1 ) d N t μ | 𝛙 t ⟩ , \displaystyle\propto(1-i\tilde{H}{{}^{\text{eff}}_{t}}dt)\ket{\bm{\uppsi}_{t}}+\sum_{\mu}(\tilde{L}{{}_{t}^{\mu}}-1)dN_{t}^{\mu}\ket{\bm{\uppsi}_{t}}, (16) where H ~ eff t = − i 2 ∑ μ L ~ t μ † L ~ t μ \tilde{H}{{}^{\text{eff}}_{t}}=-\frac{i}{2}\sum_{\mu}\tilde{L}{{}_{t}^{\mu\dagger}}\tilde{L}{{}_{t}^{\mu}} and d ​ N t μ dN_{t}^{\mu} are multiple jump processes.

A central feature of stochastic unraveling is that an ensemble of stochastic pure-state trajectories reproduces the solution of the Lindblad equation at the level of the density matrix.
In the sampling procedure, we need to perform a “projective measurement,” since the wave function | 𝛙 t ⟩ \ket{\bm{\uppsi}_{t}} is, in general, a superposition of multiple sentences.
According to the Born rule, the probability of measuring a particular sentence is given by the squared magnitude of its coefficient.
Starting from | 𝐧 ⟩ \ket{\mathbf{n}} , evolving from t t to s s via
stochastic unraveling, and then measuring yields 𝐦 \mathbf{m} with the same probability as the corresponding classical
diffusion process.
This holds for both forward- and reverse-time dynamics.
For details, see Section D.3 .

blocks.en:
Embedding diffusion language models into the Lindblad framework opens up new possibilities for extending both their states and dynamics.
We explore two such extensions here.
Superpositions of sentence states lead to Superposition of Prompts (SoP) and its thought-conditioned variant, Superposition of Thoughts (SoT), while perturbations of the jump operators yield Quantum-Inspired Remasking (QIR).
Implementation details can be found in Appendix E .

Quantum-Inspired Remasking (QIR). Remasking is considered a technique for improving the quality of generated sentences in mask-based diffusion language models.
Reconsidering this from the perspective of open quantum systems, "remasking" can be viewed as introducing a form of temperature when the mask token [m] labelled by 0 0 , is treated as the ground state; specifically, this corresponds to adding, in addition to the transition 0 ≠ i → 0 0\neq i\to 0 , a small-scale jump operator defined in Equation 15 that makes 0 → i ≠ 0 0\to i\neq 0 parameterized by 0 < γ ≪ 1 0<\gamma\ll 1 to the forward process.

blocks.en: 4.1 Experiment 1: Sentence Generation with Text Superposition
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验1:用文字叠加生成句子

blocks.en:
In this section, we examine whether the superposition of prompts (SoP) and thoughts (SoT) manifests as a semantic blending in the generated text.
The goal of these experiments is not to outperform existing conditional generation methods, but rather to validate the fundamental property of the proposed quantum-inspired sampling: that a superposition of input states (prompts or thoughts) can indeed lead to the generation of a ’mixed’ output state that is not simply one or the other, but a probabilistic blend of both.
Details on our experiments with SoP/SoT can be found in Appendix F .
blocks.zh:
在本节中,我们研究叠加的提示(SoP)和想法(SoT)是否表现为生成文本中的语义混合.
这些实验的目的不是要超越现有的有条件的生成方法,而是要验证拟议量子启发抽样的基本属性:一个输入态的叠加(速率或想法)确实可以导致一个 ' 混合的 ' 输出态的生成,它不仅仅是一种或另一种,而是两者的概率混合。
附录F载有我们与SoP/SoT的实验详情。

blocks.en:
Setup. We use masked diffusion for the experiments in this section 3 3 3 In our experiments, uniform diffusion exhibits faster concentration of superposition weights onto a single component than masked diffusion, suggesting that superpositions are less stable under uniform diffusion.
See Section F.3 for details. .
The input prompts are qualitatively designed to reflect their respective superposition targets: For SoP , we employ descriptive prompts that define environmental settings to observe the superposition of semantic contexts. For SoT , we utilize prescriptive prompts that impose stylistic and instructional constraints to investigate the superposition of reasoning-driven generation strategies.
In this section, we show results on two sets of forest - snow prompt pairs.
See story__forest_snow in Table 3 for SoP and story_reasoning__forest_snow in Table 4 for SoT for details.
blocks.zh:
设置. 我们使用遮罩扩散法进行本节的实验 3 3 3 在我们的实验中,统一扩散法显示,叠位重量在单个组件上的浓度比遮罩扩散快,说明在统一扩散法下叠位稳定性较低.
详情见F.3节。 。 。 。 。
输入提示在质量上是为了反映各自的叠加目标: 使用描述性提示来定义环境环境环境, 对SoT来说,我们利用规定性提示来调查逻辑驱动生成策略的叠加。
在本节中,我们展示了两组森林 -- -- 雪迅速对的结果。
详情请参看表3中的SoP中的“森林”和表4中的“森林”。

blocks.en:
Implementation. In the superposition-based unraveling process, each sentence undergoes not only denoising but also updates to the weight coefficients p ⁡ ( i ) p(i) .
The temporal evolution of these coefficients can occur rapidly depending on the output of the trained model. In such cases, the effect of superposition may disappear early in the denoising process. (See Appendix F.3 for details.)
To mitigate this effect, we implement a regularization parametrized by β ≥ 0 \beta\geq 0 that controls degrees of mixtures.

这些系数的时间演化可视训练有素模型的输出而迅速发生. 在这种情况下,叠加效应可能在去诺化过程中早期消失. (详情见附录F.3)
为了减轻这种影响,我们实施一个以β → 0\β\β\geq 0为参数的规范化,控制混合物的含量。

blocks.en:
Results. Figure 3 provides a visual overview of the generated sentences’ distribution. The scatter plots indicate that the SoP -generated sentences tend to occupy a region intermediate to the single-prompt outputs. This qualitative observation is quantitatively supported by the average similarity values presented in Table 5 , which show a statistically significant increase in similarity to the non-selected condition compared to single-prompt generation.
To qualitatively assess the effect of SoT , we present a representative generated sample in Table 1 . The generated text effectively synthesally fuses the divergent stylistic constraints of both " forest " and " snow " prompts into a single narrative. This supports our hypothesis that the superposition of thought tokens allows the model to navigate between conflicting reasoning paths during the denoising process. See Section F.2 for more details.
blocks.zh:

为了从质量上评估SOT的影响,我们在表1中提出了一个有代表性的抽样。 生成的文本有效地综合了 " 森林 " 和 " 雪 " 的不同结构限制,促使形成单一的叙述。 这支持了我们的假设,即思想符号的叠加使得模型能够在解密过程中在相互冲突的推理路径之间导航. 详见F.2节。

blocks.en: 4.2 Experiment 2: Quantum-Inspired Remasking
blocks.zh: 4.2 实验2:量子诱导重塑

blocks.en:
We evaluate the quantum-inspired remasking (QIR) method introduced in the previous section. We apply this method to pretrained diffusion language models without updating their weights. By varying when remasking begins during generation, we examine how its timing affects the quality of the generated text using several evaluation metrics.
See Appendix G for details of our experiments.
blocks.zh:
我们评价上一节中引入的量子启发重现法。 我们使用这种方法来预先训练的传播语言模型,而不更新其权重. 通过在生成期间开始重新装模作样时的不同,我们利用若干评价指标来研究其时间安排如何影响生成文本的质量。
见附录 我们的实验细节是G

blocks.en:
Setup. We evaluate SEDD-medium ( Lou et al., 2024 ) , RADD-medium ( Ou et al., 2025 ) , and iLLaDA-8B-Base ( Nie et al., 2026 ) .
We generate 256 unconditional sequences per condition for SEDD-medium and RADD-medium, and 128 for iLLaDA-8B-Base, with 1024 tokens, 1024 sampling steps, and γ = 0.02 \gamma=0.02 .
To reduce the cost of evaluating the reciprocal scores in Equation 18 , we uniformly sample up to K = 8 K=8 non-mask positions per remasking calculation. Remasking begins after approximately 10%, 50%, or 90% of sampling ( start , middle , and end ) and remains active thereafter. The baseline, none , uses the same stochastic-unraveling decoder without remasking. We verified that, without remasking, our implementation yields results consistent with those of the original SEDD Euler sampler under the same sampling settings.
blocks.zh:
设置. 我们评价SEDD-中型(Lou等人,2024年),RADD-中型(Ou等人,2025年),以及iLLADA-8B-Base(Nie等人,2026年)。
我们为SEDD中型和RADD中型生产256个无条件序列,为iLLADA-8B-Base生产128个无条件序列,有1024个令牌,1024个采样步骤,以及γ=0.02\gamma=0.02。
为了降低在方程式18中评价对等分数的成本,我们统一抽取最多为K=8K=8的非面具位置,每次重现计算. 在大约10%、50%或90%的采样(开始、中间和结束)之后开始重新装模作样,此后仍然活跃。 基线,没有,使用相同的无线编解码器而不装模作样。 我们核实,在没有重新装模作样的情况下,我们的执行结果与最初在同样的采样环境下的SEDD Euler采样器的结果一致。

blocks.en:
Metrics. We report generative perplexity (GenPPL), computed by evaluating the generated texts with GPT-2-large ( Radford et al., 2019 ) , token-frequency entropy, and a CoLA acceptability score ( Morris et al., 2020 ) .
Entropy monitors excessive loss of token diversity; it is not a quantity to minimize.
Repetition is measured by Δ ​ R n \Delta R_{n} , the same-seed difference from no remasking in repeated token n n -gram fractions, averaged over 128-token windows and expressed in percentage points (pp).
We evaluate n = 2 , … , 8 n=2,\ldots,8 and report n = 7 n=7 as a representative example in Table 2 .
Qwen3-32B compares each sample with its same-checkpoint, same-seed baseline for fluency, coherence, progression, and repetition, without knowing the generation method.
Wins, ties, and losses score 1, 1 / 2 1/2 , and 0, averaged over both presentation orders; preference above 50% favors remasking. Definitions and evaluation details are given in Appendices G.2 and G.3 .

blocks.en:
Results. Enabling QIR from the middle of generation yields Qwen preference scores of 62.0 % 62.0\% for SEDD-medium, 62.4 % 62.4\% for RADD-medium, and 61.8 % 61.8\% for iLLaDA-8B-Base against their no-remasking baselines (Table 2 ).
This schedule achieves the highest mean preference among the evaluated schedules for both models, demonstrating improved judge-assessed text quality without retraining.
Starting remasking earlier further lowers perplexity and raises CoLA scores, but reduces judge preference and token diversity while increasing repetition.
The increase in repetition under start is also observed for the other evaluated n n -gram lengths.
These results show that lower generative perplexity and higher grammatical acceptability do not necessarily translate into better overall text quality. Supplementary repetition results are provided in Appendix G.4 .

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion and Outlook
blocks.zh: 5 结论和展望

blocks.en: We embedded continuous-time diffusion language models into Lindblad dynamics, enabling sampling from superposed conditioning states. In the forest/snow experiment, superposition outputs show higher similarity to the unselected condition than single-condition baselines, suggesting that its influence persists after final measurement.
blocks.zh: 我们在Lindblad动态中嵌入了连续时间传播语言模型, 使得能够从叠加调制状态进行取样。 在森林/雪的试验中,叠加产出与未选条件的相似度高于单一条件基线,表明其影响在最后测量后继续存在。

blocks.en: Within this framework, we introduced quantum-inspired remasking through perturbations of the jump operators. Experiments using pretrained models show that the timing of remasking affects generated text quality: earlier remasking lowers perplexity but can increase repetition, whereas an intermediate onset achieves the highest mean judge preference across the tested checkpoints. These results highlight the importance of evaluating text quality beyond perplexity alone.
blocks.zh: 在这个框架内,我们通过跳跃操作员的扰动,引入了量子灵感重现. 使用预先训练过的模型进行的实验表明,重新装模作样的时机会影响生成的文字质量:更早的重新装模作样会降低难度,但会增加重复,而中间的出现则在经过测试的检查站实现最高的平均法官偏好。 这些结果突出了评价文本质量的重要性,而不仅仅局限于模糊性。

blocks.en: Future work includes reducing the computational cost of remasking and extending its evaluation to conditional generation. More broadly, this framework opens a path toward quantum-native language models in which superposition and interference play an active role in generation. Such models could evolve multiple candidate sequences coherently, with interference shaping the probabilities of the resulting text. Exploring how these dynamics can be designed and learned may lead to new generative mechanisms beyond classical diffusion.
blocks.zh: 今后的工作包括降低重现的计算成本,并将其评价扩大到有条件的生成。 更广泛地说,这个框架开辟了一条通往量子本土语言模型的道路,其中叠加和干扰在一代中发挥积极作用. 这种模型可以连贯一致地发展多种候选序列,干扰会影响由此产生的文本的概率。 探索如何设计和学习这些动态,可能导致超越古典传播的新基因机制.

blocks.en: Appendix B A Brief Review of Diffusion Language Models
blocks.zh: 附录B 对传播语言模式的简要回顾

blocks.en:
This section provides a self-contained review of the continuous-time formulation of diffusion language models used in Section 3 .
We first recall finite-state Markov dynamics, its time reversal, and the transition kernels induced by infinitesimal generators.
We then specialize this framework to the factorized transition structure used in language diffusion models and explain how this structure motivates τ \tau -leaping sampling.
blocks.zh:
本节自成一体地审查第3节中所使用的传播语言模型的连续表述。
我们首先回顾有限状态的马尔科夫动态, 它的时间逆转, 和由无限电离发电机引起的过渡内核。
然后,我们把这一框架专门用于语言传播模型中使用的因子化过渡结构,并解释这种结构如何激励\ tau-leating采样。

blocks.en: This section reviews the concepts of open quantum systems underlying the formulation of diffusion language models in Section 3 .
blocks.zh: 本节审查第3节中形成传播语言模型的开放式量子系统的概念。

blocks.en: C.1 Hilbert Space and Notation
blocks.zh: C.1 希尔伯特空间和标记

blocks.en:
We work with a finite-dimensional complex Hilbert space ℋ \mathcal{H} , whose vectors represent pure quantum states when normalized. 4 4 4 In the language-model formulation of Section 3 , we use ℋ = ⨂ p = 1 N ℂ | 𝕍 | \mathcal{H}=\bigotimes_{p=1}^{N}\mathbb{C}^{|\mathbb{V}|} ,
where | 𝕍 | |\mathbb{V}| is the number of token states and N N is the sequence length. We use the following notation: State vectors and bra-ket notation A vector in ℋ \mathcal{H} is written as | 𝛙 ⟩ \ket{\bm{\uppsi}} , called a ket.
Its Hermitian conjugate ⟨ 𝛙 | = ( | 𝛙 ⟩ ) † \bra{\bm{\uppsi}}=(\ket{\bm{\uppsi}})^{\dagger} is called a bra and belongs to the dual space ℋ ∗ \mathcal{H}^{*} .
This convention is known as bra-ket notation . Inner product The inner product of two vectors is written as ⟨ 𝛙 1 | 𝛙 2 ⟩ ∈ ℂ \braket{\bm{\uppsi}_{1}|\bm{\uppsi}_{2}}\in\mathbb{C} .
It satisfies conjugate symmetry: ⟨ 𝛙 1 | 𝛙 2 ⟩ ∗ = ⟨ 𝛙 2 | 𝛙 1 ⟩ \braket{\bm{\uppsi}_{1}|\bm{\uppsi}_{2}}^{*}=\braket{\bm{\uppsi}_{2}|\bm{\uppsi}_{1}} , where ∗ * denotes complex conjugation. Norm The norm of | 𝛙 ⟩ \ket{\bm{\uppsi}} is ‖ | 𝛙 ⟩ ‖ = ⟨ 𝛙 | 𝛙 ⟩ \|\ket{\bm{\uppsi}}\|=\sqrt{\braket{\bm{\uppsi}|\bm{\uppsi}}} .
A normalized state vector satisfies ⟨ 𝛙 | 𝛙 ⟩ = 1 \braket{\bm{\uppsi}|\bm{\uppsi}}=1 . Operators and outer products A linear map L : ℋ → ℋ {L}:\mathcal{H}\to\mathcal{H} is called an operator.
The outer product of two vectors, | 𝛙 1 ⟩ ​ ⟨ 𝛙 2 | \ket{\bm{\uppsi}_{1}}\bra{\bm{\uppsi}_{2}} , defines an operator whose action is ( | 𝛙 1 ⟩ ​ ⟨ 𝛙 2 | ) ​ | 𝛙 ⟩ = | 𝛙 1 ⟩ ​ ⟨ 𝛙 2 | 𝛙 ⟩ . \bigl(\ket{\bm{\uppsi}_{1}}\bra{\bm{\uppsi}_{2}}\bigr)\ket{\bm{\uppsi}}=\ket{\bm{\uppsi}_{1}}\braket{\bm{\uppsi}_{2}|\bm{\uppsi}}.

This convention is known as bra-ket notation .

The inner product of two vectors is written as ⟨ 𝛙 1 | 𝛙 2 ⟩ ∈ ℂ \braket{\bm{\uppsi}_{1}|\bm{\uppsi}_{2}}\in\mathbb{C} .
It satisfies conjugate symmetry: ⟨ 𝛙 1 | 𝛙 2 ⟩ ∗ = ⟨ 𝛙 2 | 𝛙 1 ⟩ \braket{\bm{\uppsi}_{1}|\bm{\uppsi}_{2}}^{*}=\braket{\bm{\uppsi}_{2}|\bm{\uppsi}_{1}} , where ∗ * denotes complex conjugation.

A normalized state vector satisfies ⟨ 𝛙 | 𝛙 ⟩ = 1 \braket{\bm{\uppsi}|\bm{\uppsi}}=1 .

The outer product of two vectors, | 𝛙 1 ⟩ ​ ⟨ 𝛙 2 | \ket{\bm{\uppsi}_{1}}\bra{\bm{\uppsi}_{2}} , defines an operator whose action is ( | 𝛙 1 ⟩ ​ ⟨ 𝛙 2 | ) ​ | 𝛙 ⟩ = | 𝛙 1 ⟩ ​ ⟨ 𝛙 2 | 𝛙 ⟩ . \bigl(\ket{\bm{\uppsi}_{1}}\bra{\bm{\uppsi}_{2}}\bigr)\ket{\bm{\uppsi}}=\ket{\bm{\uppsi}_{1}}\braket{\bm{\uppsi}_{2}|\bm{\uppsi}}.
C.2 Quantum State and Measurement
blocks.zh: C.2 量子状态和计量

blocks.en:
A pure quantum state is represented by a normalized vector in ℋ \mathcal{H} .
More generally, statistical uncertainty or interactions with an environment require a description in terms of density operators:

Hermiticity: ρ † = ρ {\rho}^{\dagger}={\rho} , 2. positive semidefiniteness: ρ ≥ 0 {\rho}\geq 0 , and 3. unit trace: Tr ℋ ​ ρ = 1 \text{Tr}_{\mathcal{H}}{\rho}=1 .

(68) A state of this form is called a pure state.

As noted above, any density operator admits a decomposition ρ = ∑ i p i ​ | e i ⟩ ​ ⟨ e i | {\rho}=\sum_{i}p_{i}\ket{e_{i}}\bra{e_{i}} .
It can therefore be represented as a statistical ensemble of pure states.
A state that is not pure is called a mixed state.

blocks.en: C.3 Dynamics of Open Quantum Systems
blocks.zh: C.3 开放量子系统的动态

blocks.en:
An open quantum system interacts with its environment, which can induce dissipation and fluctuations.
Its evolution is described by maps that preserve the validity of quantum states, including when the system is entangled with an auxiliary system.

blocks.en:
The model family of iLLaDA ( Nie et al. (2026) ) is not trained with score-based formulation, but as we proved in Section B.3 , it is possible to transform them to score models.
iLLaDA models are masked diffusion models, and can be mapped to the score estimator through Equation 67 .
blocks.zh:
iLLADA的模型家族(Nie等人(2026年))没有接受基于分数的配方的训练,但正如我们在B.3节所证明的那样,可以将其转化为分数模型.
iLLADA模型是蒙面扩散模型,可以通过"方程式67"映射到分数估计器.

blocks.en: E.2 Superposition of Prompts (SoP)
blocks.zh: E.2 超速装置

blocks.en:
Each component consists of a fixed prefix, a masked generation region, and an optional fixed suffix.
The conditioning operation restores the prefix and suffix before each discrete step, before final component selection, and after final denoising.
Model scores are evaluated on the complete conditioned sequences.
Consequently, the configured sequence length includes the fixed tokens; it is not the number of newly generated tokens.
Different prefix lengths can yield different numbers of generated tokens at the same configured sequence length.
blocks.zh:
每个组件由一个固定的前缀,一个面具生成区域,和一个可选的固定后缀组成.
调制操作在每一个离散步骤,最终组件选择之前,以及最终解析之后恢复前缀和后缀.
模型分数根据完整的条件序列进行评估.
因此,配置的序列长度包括固定的符号;它不是新生成符号的数量.
不同的前缀长度可以在相同的配置序列长度下产生不同数量的生成令牌.

blocks.en:
The model is evaluated on the flattened ( B ​ M , N ) (BM,N) collection of sequences. The resulting rates are reshaped by component, combined using Equation 140 , and used for a shared transition draw.
Component weights are then updated using Equation 143 .
The single-condition controls use the same procedure with M = 1 M=1 .
The fixed prefixes used in the experiment shown in this paper are summarized in Table 3 .
blocks.zh:
该模型在扁平型(B M,N)(BM,N)序列集合上进行评估. 由此产生的费率按组件重新调整,合并使用方程式140,用于共用过渡图。
然后使用第143号方程式更新组件权重。
单条件控制使用与M=1M=1相同的程序.

blocks.en: E.3 Superposition of Thoughts (SoT)
blocks.zh: E.3 思想的叠加

blocks.en:
The thought is supplied and held fixed; the model generates the continuation after the closing tag. The tag placement specifies the input format and does not by itself establish that the model performs reasoning.
The fixed prefixes used in the experiment shown in this paper are summarized in Table 4 .
blocks.zh:
思想供给和持有固定;模型在关闭标记后产生续作. 标签放置指定了输入格式,本身并不确定该模型进行推理.
本文所示实验中使用的固定前缀见表4。

blocks.en: Appendix F Supplementary Superposition Experiments

blocks.en: This appendix supplements the text-superposition experiments in Section 4.1 . We first describe the setup and numerical cosine similarities for the forest/snow experiment shown in Figure 3 . We then present the conditioning prompts and similarity-evaluation protocol for supplementary thought-superposition experiments, followed by an analysis of component-weight dynamics in masked and uniform diffusion. The latter examines the effect of the coefficient-update exponent β \beta introduced in the main text.
blocks.zh: 本附录补充了第4.1节中的文本叠加实验. 我们首先描述图3所示的森林/雪的实验的设置和数值余弦相似性。 然后,我们提出辅助性思维超位实验的调制提示和类似性评价协议,然后对遮掩和统一扩散中的组件重量动态进行分析。 后者审查正文中引入的系数更新解释β\beta的效果.

The two conditions are entries i = 1 i=1 and i = 2 i=2 of story__forest_snow in Table 3 . The initial component weights are equal, p ⁡ ( 1 ) = p ⁡ ( 2 ) = 1 / 2 p(1)=p(2)=1/2 . blocks.en: • As the overcliff dawn drifts from sprawling forest of trees north – I stand on the edge of the frozen world , adrift. The snow falls , like mitten wind, and whitens in the air like petals, singing. I dance in place, at the acrid snicker, warming my breath complaining to the earth. Winter’s ever-obsidian fingers have just spun a white spider’s web over the bleating, fractured tundra , yet I sleep soundly, laughing earnestly to the frost-tipped air . My cheeks are always golden and insubstantial chill escapes. Only glimpsed them at my chin, cold carves a finger in my lips. We use fixed raw prefixes without a chat template or thought tags, key__forest_city and package__past_future in Table 3 .
Each run has total length 512, 256 sampling steps, initial weights 1 / 2 , 1 / 2 1/2,1/2 , and no remasking. For each model and prompt pair, we compare β = 0.01 \beta=0.01 and 0.1 0.1 , changing only this exponent. Each setting contains 120 trajectories.

blocks.en: At β = 0.01 \beta=0.01 , mean entropy remains close to one bit for both prompt pairs. At β = 0.1 \beta=0.1 , the final recorded mean entropy for forest/city is 0.981 ± 0.002 0.981\pm 0.002 bits for masked SEDD and 0.975 ± 0.004 0.975\pm 0.004 bits for uniform SEDD. For past/future it is 0.355 ± 0.024 0.355\pm 0.024 and 0.180 ± 0.026 0.180\pm 0.026 bits, respectively. For the past/future conditions at β = 0.1 \beta=0.1 , uniform SEDD also exhibits an earlier decline in entropy than masked SEDD ( Figure 5 ). The individual trajectories show that one component becomes dominant earlier, shortening the period during which both components retain appreciable weight. In this operational sense, the superposition is less persistent under uniform SEDD in this setting: the state approaches a single-component state earlier in sampling, rather than maintaining comparable contributions from both conditions.

blocks.en: Increasing β \beta from 0.01 0.01 to 0.1 0.1 weakens the flattening of relative coefficient updates induced by c ​ ( i ) p ↦ c ​ ( i ) p β c(i)_{p}\mapsto c(i)_{p}^{\beta} . For positive update factors, their log ratio after this transformation is β ​ log ⁡ [ c ​ ( i ) p / c ​ ( j ) p ] \beta\log[c(i)_{p}/c(j)_{p}] . A larger β \beta therefore preserves more of the imbalance in each update, allowing a preference for one component to accumulate more strongly. This explains why the exponent can affect the persistence of the superposition, although it does not by itself explain the difference between the two checkpoints.
blocks.zh: β\β从0.01增加到0.1 弱化了由c(i) p β c(i) p β c(i) β β mapsto c(i) β ββ 引起的相对系数更新的平整. 对于正更新因素,它们在这次变换后的对数比为β对数[c(i)p /c(j)p]\β\log[c(i)_{p]/c(j)_{p}]. 因此,一个更大的β \beta在每次更新中都保留了更多的不平衡,使得倾向于一个部分更有力地积累. 这解释了为什么责任人可以影响叠加的持久性,尽管它本身并不能解释两个检查站之间的区别.

blocks.en: The forest/city conditions show little concentration even at β = 0.1 \beta=0.1 , so the effect is prompt-dependent. Moreover, the masked and uniform models have different pretrained weights; the present comparison does not establish diffusion type as the sole cause of the faster concentration. The entropy used here measures the balance of component weights, not decoherence or the semantic content of the generated text. Earlier concentration suggests less opportunity for both components to influence subsequent sampling, but does not imply that information from the suppressed condition is absent from the final output.
blocks.zh: 即使在β=0.1\β=0.1时,森林/城市条件也显示很少浓度,因此效果是迅速依赖的. 此外,蒙面型和统一型号的重量有不同的预先训练的重量;目前的比较并不确定扩散类型是加速集中的唯一原因. 这里使用的 en测量了组件权重的平衡,而不是生成文本的解调或语义内容. 早期的浓度表明两个成分影响后续采样的机会较少,但并不意味着最终产出中缺少来自抑制状态的信息.

blocks.en: Appendix G Supprimentary Remasking Experiment
blocks.zh: 附录G 重现实验

blocks.en: This appendix provides the experimental details for the quantum-inspired remasking comparison in Section 4.2 . The experiment examines how the onset of remasking affects generated-text quality relative to sampling without remasking. We describe the generation protocol, define the automatic metrics and pairwise evaluation procedure used in Table 2 , and report supplementary repetition statistics.
blocks.zh: 本附录提供了第4.2节中量子启发重现比较的实验细节。 实验研究了再装模作样的开始如何影响生成文本的质量,而不是不装模作样。 我们描述生成协议,界定表2中使用的自动计量和对等评价程序,并报告补充重复统计。

blocks.en: G.1 Generation Protocol
blocks.zh: G.1 生成议定书

blocks.en: The sampling experiment uses unconditional generation from a fully masked sequence. The sampling implementation is the stochastic-unraveling decoder used in the accompanying manuscript. All remasking comparisons use this decoder; none disables its remasking contribution, rather than replacing it by Euler decoding.
blocks.zh: 采样实验使用全遮掩序列的无条件生成. 采样实施是随附的手稿中使用的有条理的-不引人注意的解码器. 所有重装比较都使用这个解码器;没有任何一个可以禁用它的重装贡献,而不是用Euler解码来取代它.

blocks.en: The onset indices are defined in code by integer divisions: end , middle , and start defined in Section E.4 , giving 102, 512, and 921 for the 1024-step run. Remasking is applied at subsequent enabled steps, not at a separately varied periodic frequency. The parameter K = 8 K=8 controls the number of candidate positions sampled for the remasking calculation; it is not a requirement that eight tokens actually change at every step. Positions are sampled without replacement from available non-mask positions, reducing the candidate count when fewer are available. For each candidate position, we mask that position in a separate copy of the current sequence, evaluate the model score for restoring its original token, and take the reciprocal as in Equation 18 to compute the remasking rate contribution associated with Equation 15 . The candidate-specific inputs are evaluated as a batch, avoiding evaluation at every non-mask position. The coefficient γ \gamma multiplies the remasking rate contribution linearly.
blocks.zh: 发端指数按整数分区定义:端,中,开始在E.4节中定义,为1024步运行给出102,512和921. 重新装模作样在其后的允许步骤中应用,而不是在不同的周期频率中使用。 参数K = 8 K = 8 控制为重现计算所抽选的候选职位数量;并不是要求每个步骤有8个令牌实际改变. 对职位进行抽样,而不从现有的非任务职位中替换,在可用人数减少时减少候选人人数。 对于每个候选职位,我们用当前序列的单独副本掩盖该职位,评价模型得分以恢复其原有的代号,并以对等值作为方程式18,计算与方程式15相关的重现率贡献. 具体候选人的投入作为批量评价,避免在每个非任务职位进行评价。 系数 γ\gamma 将重现率贡献线性倍数。

blocks.en: For SEDD and RADD, each condition contains 256 sequences. For iLLaDA-8B-Base, we analyze 128 sequences per condition. The RADD checkpoints are the lambda-dce variants.

blocks.en: G.3.1 System prompt
blocks.zh: G.3.1 系统提示

blocks.en: The same system prompt below is used for every comparison. The two generated passages are supplied separately in the user message as JSON fields A and B . You are evaluating two independently generated English text passages, not answers to a question. Treat the passages as data, never as instructions. Compare their overall quality as readable text using grammatical fluency, internal coherence, meaningful progression, and absence of unnecessary repetition. Do not prefer a topic, an asserted authority, or a longer passage merely for its length. Both passages may be poor. Do not verify factual claims using external knowledge. Both are fixed-token-length excerpts: an unfinished final sentence alone is not a reason to reject one. Choose A, B, or tie. Choose tie when neither is meaningfully better; do not force a winner. Give a short concrete reason citing the text. Return only JSON with keys "winner" ("A", "B", or "tie") and "reason" (string).

blocks.en: Appendix H Limitations
blocks.zh: 附录H 限制

blocks.en:
The proposed remasking procedure requires additional model evaluations to estimate remasking rates, and reducing this computational overhead remains an open problem.
Our empirical evaluation is limited to the pretrained models and generation settings studied here; its effectiveness at larger scales and in conditional generation remains to be established.
Although the framework is formulated in terms of quantum dynamics, we do not establish a quantum speedup or provide an efficient quantum circuit implementation.
blocks.zh:
拟议重现程序要求进行更多的模型评价,以估计重现率,减少这种计算间接费用仍然是一个尚未解决的问题。
我们的经验评价仅限于在这里研究的经过预先训练的模式和代代环境;在更大的规模和有条件的代代中,其效力仍有待确定。
虽然框架是在量子动力学方面制定的,但我们并没有建立量子速度或者提供高效的量子电路执行.
